identityMethod: file > describe-chain > leaf-title header line as vitest prints it (the full ' FAIL |core|  <...>' text) is the identity key. Primary = the first non-empty message line before the first ' ❯ ' stack-frame line (outer/line-trailing whitespace trimmed only). Frame = the first stack frame whose path matches (tests|ui/src)/...\.test\.tsx?:LINE:COL (the first TEST-FILE frame, which may be a shared helper's own call site rather than the deepest production frame). Shared-header groups (multiple FAIL headers printed once above one shared error body) are expanded to one row per header, all sharing that group's primary/frame. RETAINED-SAME = identity present in both runs with byte-identical primary. RETAINED-CHANGED = identity present in both with a different primary. NEW = identity only in 1302. VANISHED = identity only in 1100.

rows.primary: Error: C2a-M1 (§8.3, the widened-leaf boundary rule) contract not met: a GENUINE V13 save — one carrying no `bindings` leaf, no `set-unavailable` arm and none of the four new roots, which is what every pre-C2 file on a player's disk looks like — was refused at the V13 boundary. §8.3: "the workflow exact-key list and the blocker validator become version-aware — pre-V14 boundaries still REFUSE `bindings` and the `set-unavailable` arm; V14 requires them." REFUSING a bindings leaf is only half the rule: a V13 file that HAS none must still load, or every save on disk is unreadable and there is nothing left for the migrator to migrate. REFUSING a bindings leaf is only half the rule: a V13 file that HAS none must still load, or every save on disk is unreadable and there is nothing left for the migrator to migrate. The refusal was: validateSaveV12: state has unknown field "firstTakeSubjects"
rows.evidence: tests/contracts/_v14Contract.ts, Module.v13TwinOf (line ~505-522): builds a 'genuine V13 twin' by stripping later roots from the current carrier, then calls validateSaveV13. Current failure: 'validateSaveV12: state has unknown field "firstTakeSubjects"' -- the twin-builder has not been updated to also strip the firstTakeSubjects root added since it was authored, so the intended widened-leaf-boundary assertion (bindings/set-unavailable refusal) is masked. Matches 1119-A's already-documented v13TwinOf/_v14Contract.ts:469 cause family for c2a-m2-sets-save.test.ts.
